copyonwritearraylist-concept.title: CopyOnWriteArrayList
copyonwritearraylist-concept.short: Use a concurrent list for read-heavy workloads
copyonwritearraylist-concept.summary: CopyOnWriteArrayList copies its backing array on updates so readers can iterate over stable snapshots.
copyonwritearraylist-concept.why: It can reduce explicit locking for shared lists that are read often and changed rarely.
copyonwritearraylist-concept.tips: Each mutation copies the array, so avoid it for write-heavy workloads.

phaser-concept.title: Phase synchronization with Phaser
phaser-concept.summary: Phaser supports dynamically registered parties and repeated synchronization phases.
phaser-concept.why: It models multi-stage coordination more flexibly than a one-shot fixed-party barrier.
phaser-concept.tips: Use arriveAndDeregister when a participant has finished all remaining phases.

collections-ncopies.title: Repeat one element n times
collections-ncopies.short: Create a repeated list with Collections.nCopies
collections-ncopies.summary: Collections.nCopies returns an unmodifiable list containing the specified element the requested number of times.
collections-ncopies.why: It expresses padding or repeated initial values concisely.
collections-ncopies.tips: Every position refers to the same object when the element is mutable.

files-mismatch.title: Find where two files differ
files-mismatch.short: Use Files.mismatch to locate the first differing byte
files-mismatch.summary: Files.mismatch compares two files and returns the position of their first differing byte.
files-mismatch.why: It avoids writing a manual whole-file comparison loop.
files-mismatch.tips: It returns -1 when the files have identical content.

closed-channel-exception.title: Operating on a closed channel
closed-channel-exception.short: Do not use a channel after close
closed-channel-exception.summary: ClosedChannelException occurs when an I/O operation requires an open channel but the channel has already been closed.
closed-channel-exception.why: A closed channel cannot be reopened or reused.
closed-channel-exception.tips: Use try-with-resources to make the channel lifetime explicit.

malformed-input-exception.title: Malformed character input
malformed-input-exception.short: Detect invalid input while decoding text
malformed-input-exception.summary: MalformedInputException indicates that an input byte sequence is not valid for the selected character encoding.
malformed-input-exception.why: A mismatched encoding or damaged data can contain byte sequences the decoder cannot interpret.
malformed-input-exception.tips: Verify the input encoding and configure CodingErrorAction explicitly when appropriate.

multi-catch-related-alternatives-error.title: Related alternatives in multi-catch
multi-catch-related-alternatives-error.short: Do not combine parent and child exception types in one multi-catch
multi-catch-related-alternatives-error.summary: A multi-catch cannot list exception alternatives when one type is a subclass of another.
multi-catch-related-alternatives-error.why: The parent type already catches the child type, making the alternatives redundant.
multi-catch-related-alternatives-error.tips: Catch the common parent or use separate catch clauses when distinct handling is needed.

record-instance-field-error.title: Extra instance fields in records
record-instance-field-error.short: Do not add non-static instance fields to a record body
record-instance-field-error.summary: A record cannot declare additional instance fields beyond the components in its header.
record-instance-field-error.why: A record's state is explicitly defined by its record components.
record-instance-field-error.tips: Compute derived values in methods, or use static fields for type-wide state when appropriate.

serial-lint-warning.title: serial lint warning
serial-lint-warning.summary: javac's serial lint warning highlights declarations that may affect Java serialization compatibility.
serial-lint-warning.why: Unintended changes to serialized form can break compatibility with previously stored data.
serial-lint-warning.tips: Confirm serialization is required and declare compatibility details such as serialVersionUID when appropriate.

arrays-deepequals-nested-array-trap.title: Comparing nested arrays
arrays-deepequals-nested-array-trap.short: Use Arrays.deepEquals for nested array content
arrays-deepequals-nested-array-trap.summary: Arrays.equals on an object array compares nested array elements using their normal equals behavior.
arrays-deepequals-nested-array-trap.why: Arrays themselves do not implement content-based Object.equals.
arrays-deepequals-nested-array-trap.tips: Use Arrays.deepEquals when equality should recurse into nested arrays.
